content.short: Comunidad Cardano is a website developed to bring together all Hispanic fans of the Cardano ecosystem.
content.description:
Comunidad Cardano is a Spanish-speaking project dedicated to the Cardano ecosystem. It has a forum where users can discuss, find help, information and resources and promote their social networks and SPO. Recently we have also launched a blog on the main page to share articles of interest.

Our website is focused on giving users a space dedicated to the Cardano ecosystem in Spanish. To be able to learn, develop, find help and continue to expand their knowledge about Cardano in Spanish.

Our goal is to create an interactive space that encourages the exchange of opinions and perspectives, thus building a solid social fabric around the shared vision of Cardano and its cryptocurrency ADA.

The idea of the project was born when we saw that there was no website that gathered information and tutorials about Cardano in Spanish. In addition, the official Cardano reddit is only available in English and the official forum does not fulfill the function that we believed necessary to create a community where to share and discuss.

The project has been active for more than a year since its launch and is visited every day by fans of the Hispanic Cardano community. It has no advertising or profit motive and is supported by user donations.
